decision.interpretation: Bold, standalone line 'Chapter VI' structurally introduces a major document region, consistent with legislative chapter headings.
Bold, all-caps standalone line 'TRADE AGENTS FOR FOREIGN TRADERS' acts as a prominent section or subtitle heading introducing the following content.
Bold, numbered 'Section 1.' line explicitly structures the document, functioning as a legislative section heading.
Bold, numbered 'Article 50.' line serves as a formal legislative article heading introducing the subsequent clauses.
Bold, numbered 'Article 51.' line functions as a formal legislative article heading introducing tax liability provisions.
Bold, numbered 'Article 52.' line functions as a formal legislative article heading introducing export/import procedures.
Bold, numbered 'Article 53.' line functions as a formal legislative article heading introducing return of goods provisions.
